_comment: Spell NAMES (as they appear in mythicsim-forever-engine/data/spells.jsonl) that Forte_Shaman tracks. gen_spell_data.py resolves each to its highest-rank spell ID + current duration/cooldown data. Names with no match in a given build are reported by the generator, not silently dropped -- re-check them after a mythicsim-forever-engine pull. Forever notes: the shaman kit gained new core spells (Riptide and Lava Lash join the shock/cooldown families, Molten Blast, Healing Rain, Decoy Totem, Stoneclaw Totem, Earthbind Totem, Feral Spirit, Rage of the Farseer, Totemic Projection); the Far Sight scry line is split into Call of the Elements/Spirits/Ancestors (L20/30/40) and Call of Flame/Thunder (L60); melee 'stamps' are Windfury/Flametongue/Rockbiter Weapon + Frostbrand. Shocks and totems often carry the cooldown as a shared category cooldown (e.g. shock category, Mana Tide category 591) -- the generator emits CategoryCooldownMs as cooldownMs. T1 (2026-11-02, docs/class-port.md 6.1 + PLAN 11.1 Q1/Q6 rulings): the reference's CAST spells are added to [cooldowns] -- Stormstrike (17364, 8 s + 12 s window), Lava Burst (1326047, 10 s shock-family category), Ancestral Guidance (the shaman pair of the paladin row; the family-11 rows 409333/409337/409944 carry no window on this build, pinned in Forte_Cooldown/tests/test_tracked_set.lua) and the family-less Q6 Heroism row (23689, durationMs -1). Maelstrom Weapon is a proc/passive: see _deferred_H7 / H7 (docs/design-combat-procs.md).
